description: Issue #851: reverts UploadImage's no-resize fast path from named arguments back to the original positional call Upload(fp, sm, groupName, csName). Upload's own signature is (fp, sm, groupName, subdir, extra, csName) -- the 4th positional slot is subdir, not csName -- so this mutant reproduces the pre-fix bug where a caller's csName silently lands in Upload's subdir parameter while Upload's own csName parameter falls back to null (the default connection), so a caller who explicitly asked for a named connection has their upload written to the default connection instead. Checked against FileApiControllerUploadImageCsNameTests851.UploadImage_NoResizeFastPath_ForwardsCallersCsNameToUpload_NotIntoSubdirSlot, which records every cskey value forwarded to Wtm.CreateDC and asserts the caller's original csName ('wtmtest2') is among them -- not merely that the request returns 200, since the buggy code path also returns 200 (it silently uses the wrong connection rather than erroring).
target_symbol: FileApiController.UploadImage(WtmFileProvider,int?,int?,string,string,string,string,string) -- the no-resize fast path's Upload(...) call, line ~55

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Admin.Test.FileApiContro: #851: UploadImage's no-resize fast path called Upload\(fp, sm, groupName, csName\) POSITIONALLY

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured against a clean checkout (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first) with the mutant patch applied: "Assert.IsTrue failed. #851: UploadImage's no-resize fast path called Upload(fp, sm, groupName, csName) POSITIONALLY -- Upload's own 4th parameter is `subdir`, not `csName`, so the caller-supplied csName ('wtmtest2') landed in Upload's subdir slot while Upload's own csName parameter silently fell back to null (the default connection). Wtm.CreateDC(cskey:) must be called with the caller's ORIGINAL csName, not null -- otherwise the upload silently lands on the wrong connection. Recorded CreateDC cskey calls: [<null>]."
